items.name: Total company backlog, Q3 FY2026
items.claim: AECOM's total backlog increased 13% year over year to a record high, driven by a record $4.2 billion of new wins that produced a 1.6x book-to-burn ratio.
items.source_excerpt: Total backlog 6 increased by 13% to a record high, driven by a record $4.2 billion in wins that resulted in a 1.6 book-to-burn 7 ratio.

notes: Q3 FY2026 8-K earnings release is the only stored evidence for AECOM; the design pipeline (early- and late-stage pursuits) also hit a new all-time high per the same release but with no disclosed dollar figure, so it is not written as a separate item.
